corrections.sourceJa: ベタ基礎は、建物の下の広い範囲を面で支える直接基礎の形式です。基礎の底盤としての面と、その上の立上りや梁などを区別すると、図面の部材を読みやすくなります。
corrections.before: A raft foundation is a direct foundation form supporting a broad area beneath a building over a surface. Distinguishing the foundation's base slab surface from upstands, beams, and other members above it makes drawing members easier to read.
corrections.translation: A raft foundation is a direct foundation form providing support over a broad surface beneath a building. Distinguishing the foundation's base slab surface from upstands, beams, and other members above it makes drawing members easier to read.
corrections.reason: Natural description of raft surface support; foundationform/base-slab/upstand/beams distinctions retained.

Direct foundations versus piles do not waive soil checks or provide capacity calculations. Raft support surface and raised members, footing spreading area, inverseT example not universal section or dimensions, illustration not standard configuration preserved.

Pile foundation form versus piling work; support not guaranteed by cylindrical pile reaching hard layer. Precast/concrete/steel/on-site shaping distinctions and no driving/drilling instructions. criticalChecks.129: Every field reread: scaffold temporary floor/passages AND supporting structure; temporary not safety-check exemption. Frame/single-tube/wedge categories and component compatibility not assumed from appearance/count. Work platform versus individual boards, support/fixings/gaps/adjacent equipment checks not completed by placing boards. criticalChecks.130: Every field reread: reinforcement arrangement names versus actual member/layer/direction/location; staggered meaning tied to drawing, no spacing rule. Takeoff materials/count/labor distinct; bar totals not people, revision scope changes and no staffing method. Clear spacing measured surface-to-surface versus center spacing; quoted あそび native gloss not arbitrary design change. Binding versus tool/named ties, no tie procedure. Cover concrete surface to bar surface, not bar center or spacing; blinding thickness not automatically added, counts not dimension proof.
criticalChecks.131: Every field reread: blinding as setting-out/formwork substrate, not unwanted waste; thickness/elevation versus structural foundation and no completion inference. Form erection maps reference lines to form faces, visible mark not correctness. Noro contextual cement paste/leak state and not universal composition/cause/treatment. criticalChecks.132: Every field reread: reuse original formwork materials across places/floors, transfer not usable-state proof; geometry alone no compatibility. criticalChecks.133: Every field reread: successive placement before prior concrete hardens; time plus material/environment/revibration-specification checks, no fixed limit. Planned joining hardened/new portions versus unintended cold joints, structural/waterproof surface conditions and no automatic performance equality. Concrete consolidation versus soil methods, surface tamping versus tapping formwork, internal filling versus slab-top finish, no vibrator/tamper operation. Mix proportions versus mixing cement/water/aggregate uniformly; measuring/performance records and no arbitrary ratios or production instructions.
